sections.title: Waybill charges overview
sections.content:
## Overview

Calculating waybill charges works the same way as calculating order charges. The system calculates automatically based on the configured charge structure, the freight rate for the route, the waybill information, and the confirmed surcharges.

sections.title: Accessing and selecting a waybill
sections.content:
### Step 1

Go to the **Freight charges** > **Waybill charges** menu.

![Freight charges menu with Waybill charges open](/uploads/023619468858299e83318bc3.png)

### Step 2

On the waybill charge management list, select the waybill you want to calculate.

![Waybill charge list](/uploads/ad7ea988278f2c1d7eecf4ac.png)

The screen opens the charge details for the selected waybill.

![Waybill charge details screen](/uploads/73c48be8876c143ae44ab17d.png)

sections.title: Conditions before calculating
sections.content:
Before calculating charges, check that:

- The correct charge structure is selected.
- A matching [freight rate](/d/freight-rates#freight-rates-overview) exists.
- All [surcharges](/d/surcharges#how-surcharges-are-applied) have been confirmed.
- The waybill data is correct.

> **Note:** For a route or a customer that appears for the first time, check and update the rate before calculating. Once the configuration is done, the system remembers it and applies it the next time.

sections.title: Loading the data
sections.content:
### Step 1

Click **Load data** on the waybill charge details screen.

![Load data button on waybill charges](/uploads/7df2d04f05b7b7fe0307ece1.png)

### Step 2

Confirm the load action when the system shows the dialog.

![Confirmation dialog for loading waybill charge data](/uploads/7e9d41baa7a53bd7f8e955bc.png)

Once the data has loaded, the charge items appear on the waybill charge details screen.

sections.title: Calculating
sections.content:
Click **Calculate** so the system calculates the charges from the loaded data.

![Calculate button for waybill charges](/uploads/7fd0965fdc08cd0fbb2ddc92.png)

sections.title: OK and Error statuses
sections.content:
When the calculation finishes, the status shows **OK** if the data is valid and the total freight amount is updated automatically.

If the status shows **Error**, check:

- The charge structure.
- The freight rate.
- The surcharges.
- The related waybill information.

Fix the data, load it again and recalculate before confirming.

![Waybill charge calculation result and status](/uploads/5283e010084daf1156073b05.png)

sections.title: Confirming the charges
sections.content:
Once you have checked that the result is correct and the status is **OK**, click **Confirm** to complete the waybill charge calculation.
